author: Adelaar, Alexander
title: Malagasy dialect divisions: Genetic versus emblematic criteria
notes: Consulted directly on 25 November 2026 (Project MUSE PDF in Downloads). Reviews Dez (1963), Vérin, Kottak & Gorlin (1969), Mahdi (1988), Gueunier (1988), Simon (2006), lexicostatistics and the Levenshtein method (§3), and proposes criteria for a genetic classification (§4): *li and *ti, final *t (Tables 1-6), *y > z and *w > v (Table 7), the merger of final-syllable *i and *e (Table 8), the personal prefixes *i and *ra-, numeral compounds, <in>, voice and lexical taxonomy. Tentatively a Northern-Central-Eastern branch against the southwestern dialects; the place of the western dialects is open (pp. 476-477). Malagasy in its orthography with o as u, final y as i, paragogic vowels with a breve, ŋ; PMP for PAN.
